what_this_is: Identity questions the founder has explicitly refused to let a machine gate settle. Each entry names the two identities in tension, the evidence that exists TODAY, and the evidence that would be required to bind them. Nothing here merges, retires, routes or publishes anything. An entry leaves this register only by a founder ruling recorded in the override register.
recorded_by: claude-opus-5 (agent) -- transcription of the founder's COVERAGE-002 ruling plus one further review raised by the COVERAGE-001 admission; no ruling was inferred or generalised
scope_rule: Each entry names ONE pair. Nothing here generalises: another pair in the same shape returns to the founder rather than inheriting a decision made about a different building.
standing_instruction: DO NOT MERGE AUTOMATICALLY. No downstream tool may bind a route, retire an identity, or supersede an address on the strength of an entry in this register.

reviews.question: Is 'woodspring suites indianapolis plainfield' the same building now trading as Extended Stay America Plainfield?
reviews.why_this_is_not_enough: Street and postal agreeing across DIFFERENT brands is exactly the shape a rebrand and a co-located pair both produce. The founder identity rule for this market requires at least TWO strong independent property-specific signals, and brand disagreement is a reason to look harder, not a second signal.
evidence_required_to_bind: an exact telephone match between the ESA page and the census row, OR
a property code carried by the ESA page or URL that the WoodSpring record also carries, OR
a first-party statement of the rebrand from either brand naming both flags at this address
forbidden_until_ruled: binding the ESA URL as the census row's official_url
publishing any policy read from the ESA page against the WoodSpring row
reviews.default_if_never_ruled: the WoodSpring row stays unrouted and unpublished; the ESA Plainfield page is not admitted as a separate identity

reviews.question: Does the registered 'extended stay america indianapolis castleton' row carry a stale or wrong address?

census_rows_on_bash_street_46250: extended stay america indianapolis castleton -- 8280 Bash Street
woodspring suites indianapolis castleton -- 8255 Bash Street

reviews.why_this_is_not_enough: ESA's own directory lists exactly ONE Castleton property and it names 7940 N. Shadeland Ave. Both addresses cannot be the ESA Castleton. Either the census row's address is wrong or stale -- in which case the correct action is an address supersession on the row we already hold -- or the Bash Street property closed. Admitting the Shadeland page as a new identity would manufacture a duplicate, so it was withheld rather than admitted.
evidence_required_to_bind: a telephone or property code shared between the ESA Castleton page and the registered row, OR
first-party confirmation that 8280 Bash Street is closed or was never ESA-branded
note: 8255 Bash Street is a SEPARATE registered WoodSpring identity and must not be disturbed by whatever is decided here
forbidden_until_ruled: admitting 7940 N. Shadeland Ave as a new census identity
binding the ESA Castleton URL to either Bash Street row
reviews.default_if_never_ruled: the registered row keeps its address and stays unrouted; the Shadeland page is admitted to nothing

reviews.raised_by: PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-CENSUS-ADMISSION-002 -- withheld from the COVERAGE-001 admission to keep the market corridor invariant
reviews.question: Should the Indianapolis corridor registry be widened to cover ZIPs 46236 and 46239, admitting these three founder-approved identities?
reviews.why_this_is_not_a_census_question: This market holds every census row to exactly one registry corridor, and the corridor decides which neighbourhood PAGE a hotel is published on. Widening the registry is therefore a market-contract and publishing decision, not the census addition COVERAGE-001 authorised. Admitting these rows corridor-less would have broken the invariant; guessing a corridor would have published a hotel into a neighbourhood nobody chose.

evidence_today.identity_evidence: each page named its own address, and no census row holds any of the three addresses

options: extend an adjacent corridor (46236 sits beside keystone-castleton and east-i70; 46239 sits beside east-i70 and south)
declare a new corridor for the northeast/southeast doughnut
leave the registry as it is and keep these three out of the census
forbidden_until_ruled: admitting these three identities to the census
assigning any of them a corridor
editing the market contract corridor registry
reviews.default_if_never_ruled: the three stay out of the census and publish nothing
